channel.title: The Organized Crime and Corruption Reporting Project - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Organized Crime and Corruption Reporting Project (occrp.org)

item.title: Ex-Maldives Leader Pitched $25 Million Island Deal to Epstein, Files Show
item.description: Newly released U.S. Justice Department records show Mohamed Waheed approached Jeffrey Epstein in 2014 with a proposal to develop a private island in the Maldives, highlighting Epstein’s continued contacts with political and business figures years after his sex-crime conviction.

item.title: Eurojust-Backed Raids Uncover $364 Million Cross-Border Money Laundering Network
item.description: Eurojust-Backed Raids Uncover $364 Million Cross-Border Money Laundering Network

item.title: Corruption Threatens Democracies Worldwide, Transparency International Warns
item.description: Transparency International’s 2025 Corruption Perceptions Index shows a world where democratic institutions are weakening, civic space is shrinking, and corruption is rising—from Europe and the Americas to Asia, Africa, and the Pacific.

item.title: EU Considers Sanctions on Georgia’s Kulevi Port Over Russian Oil Links
item.description: While Georgia’s Prime Minister denies any wrongdoing, the EU is moving to blacklist the Kulevi terminal for sanctions evasion. The designation would cripple the logistics of the SOCAR-owned facility, making it "unattractive to international shipping."

item.title: Kyrgyz President Removes Close Ally From Top Security Post
item.description: The sudden removal of Kyrgyzstan’s powerful security chief ends a years-long political alliance that helped shape the country’s post-uprising leadership.

item.title: Epstein Bought Venezuelan Oil Bonds on Advice From Chávez-Era Insider
item.description: Newly released documents show businessman Francisco D’Agostino visited Jeffrey Epstein’s private island, and advised his investments in PDVSA, Venezuela’s state oil company.

item.title: Authorities Intercept Millions in Fake Banknotes and Coins Across Europe, US
item.description: Authorities Intercept Millions in Fake Banknotes and Coins Across Europe, US

item.title: Episode 3: There You Are, Carmelo
item.description: A secret recording from a clandestine sting operation reveals the plans of financial experts enlisted to help former Venezuelan oil ministry official Carmelo Urdaneta move the illicit money and bypass international banking controls.

item.title: Jeffrey Epstein Arranged Employment for Romantic Partner at Top U.S. Think Tank
item.description: Emails show Epstein helped a girlfriend obtain roles at the International Peace Institute, a New York-based think tank, and may even have subsidized her salary at one point.

item.title: US Bars Palau Senate Leader Over Alleged China Ties
item.description: The U.S. barred the president of Palau’s Senate from entering the country over allegations he accepted bribes to promote the interests of China’s government and criminal figures.
